issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console). Not user-visible but should add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the in-progress session dialog in SubscribedHome.jsx and to SessionLogDialog.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_session_logs uses provider ownership check — good. However delete_session_log silently returns {ok:true} even if id doesn't exist or belongs to another provider; consider returning 404 to prevent info hiding of failures.
customer_home does N+1 by fetching provider once per primary booking — acceptable now, but if primary grows to multiple, batch via $lookup or single find({user_id: {$in: ids}}).
server.py is 1284 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting into routers (bookings, sessions, admin, providers).
